notes: THE DETAIL PASS: 67 new props and lots of new detail across all 8 maps
Furnished interiors: the Spire penthouse living room and office, desks and whiteboards in the Whiteout lab, a briefing board in the Killhouse
Skyport: security gates, queue ropes, departure boards, luggage carts and suitcases, vending machines
Dustwater: fruit and pottery on the market stalls, rug piles, laundry lines over the alleys, satellite dishes on the roofs
Whiteout: snowmobiles, sleds, a research tent, ski racks, fuel bladders and radio masts. Blackwater Pier: lobster traps, buoys, an anchor, fish crates, pipes and valves in the cannery
Ridgeline: fences, a woodpile, a trough, a scarecrow, milk cans and a radio mast on the ridge. Stackyard: electrical boxes, drum racks, cable spools and tool chests
